analyst_view.overall: Nacional, low in the table with seven points, have new coach João Henriques. He has made them hard to break down with a back five, and they have not conceded from open play recently, including against Braga and Arouca. Bruno Pinheiro's Académico de Viseu are sixth with 20 points. Pinheiro expects a 'patient' game and says creating chances from open play will be one of the biggest challenges.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.5 goals. Under Henriques, Nacional have prioritised defence, with a back five and only one set-piece goal conceded recently. Pinheiro himself says Nacional have 'closed the doors' to their goal. Nacional have scored only four in their last six, so a low-scoring game looks likely.

corners.text: The numbers say about 8.8 corners. If Viseu have most of the ball against a deep Nacional block, they could win more corners than the model gives them, but Nacional's home share would likely drop. That roughly evens out.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.4 cards, with Pedro Ramalho refereeing. A patient, low-tempo game against a deep defence doesn't obviously add bookings, and we found no disciplinary news for either side.

shots.text: The numbers say almost 30 shots, which looks high for this game. Nacional's back five is built to limit openings, and Pinheiro expects a slow, patient build-up from his side. That points to fewer shots overall.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.4 shots on target. Viseu's coach openly expects to struggle to create clear chances against Nacional's new set-up. Nacional's attack has been weak, with four goals in six games. Expect fewer efforts on target than the model.
